page.layout: One column of running text, with a decorative ornament band above it and a large initial L. No margin notes, page number, running head or catchword.

main_text.p: Legi & expendi Disputa-tionem Theologi-cam' de Magistratu, adversus Bellarmini librum de Laicis, quam hoc anno edidit Daventriæ Clariss. & Doctiss. Vir. D. Nicolaus Vedelius, S. Th. Doct. & Professor, eamq; in tre-decim quæstiones, ordinis & perspicuitatis gratiâ, di-stribuit. Testor autem ni-hil à me animadversum esse in ejus responsionibus & solutionibus, quod non judicem [?] convenire cum o-nium.

page.notes: The ornament band above the text is decoration and is not transcribed. The large initial L is joined to "egi" as "Legi". The last word "nium" is set right-aligned on its own line as the completion of "o-nium", so it is part of the paragraph and not a catchword. "cam'" is printed with an apostrophe as shown. "judicem" is uncertain: the scan shows something like "judicein". "quæstiones" has a doubtful æ ligature. The Google digitiser watermark at bottom right is excluded.
